scope: Current source: complete private latest-per-execution evaluation history, period/verdict/agent/search filters, anchored pagination and consistent recent-window aggregates; metadata-only list reads and lazy frozen report details; separate history/alert focus restoration. baseline.interpretation: Nine failures exposed absent pagination/API behavior. The legacy mock fixture also lacked the runs.version NOT NULL field; that fixture setup was corrected before verification.

targeted_backend.note: Initial targeted run before the additional mean-rounding regression; the final full suite includes all 11 new cases.

validation_notes: Final UI suite includes history paging, stale reads, scope changes, write invalidation, Chinese input and distinct modal-source focus.
The final layout suite covers panel padding, retained-result errors and retry focus at 1024/1440 widths, light/dark themes, 100%/200% text: 8 configurations.

The last display-only addition shows the already-tested asof timestamp above the score cards; it followed the full UI and browser runs. JavaScript syntax was checked afterward. It does not alter queries, paging or the captured history panel.
Alert inbox passed before the distinct modal-source focus fix; the subsequent reading-interactions and evaluation-catalog suites verify both entrances after that fix.

The isolated evaluation history scenario issued no POST requests and made no external model calls. The established module suite intentionally performs synthetic mutations, including alert acknowledgement and evaluation-policy save.
test_helper_corrections: The legacy mock-run seed now supplies its required version column.
The layout helper uses synchronous scrollIntoView on the current element rather than waiting for stability across an ordinary background DOM refresh.
Read-only detail tests scope reminder-specific selectors to the alert inbox because the same report now also has a legitimate history entrance.
The legacy module suite waits for the selected workflow detail to succeed, rather than requiring a newly created run to appear inside an older anchored history window.

benchmark.comparison: Original overview returns 200 complete reports after decoding 267; paged endpoint returns 50 headers plus catalog statistics. This is not an equal-payload or production-load comparison.
benchmark.tradeoff: The new filtered counts and aggregates add local SQL work; the demonstrated gain is reduced complete-body decoding, transfer volume and rendered content, not faster database query latency.

release: Source only; no packaging or publishing.
